test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: It deals with the allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha.
It defines the distribution of powers between the Union and States.
It contains provisions regarding Official Languages.
It provides for disqualification of members on grounds of defection.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It provides for disqualification of members on grounds of defection.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Tenth Schedule** of the **Indian Constitution** was added through the **52nd Amendment Act of 1985**, also referred to as the **Anti-Defection Law**.
 
• This schedule lays down provisions for the **disqualification of Members of Parliament (MPs) and Members of Legislative Assemblies (MLAs)** on the grounds of defection.
